ruleName: "ThreadGroup" should not be used
specificMessage: Remove this use of "ThreadGroup". Prefer the use of "ThreadPoolExecutor".

ruleName: "Object.wait(...)" and "Condition.await(...)" should be called inside a "while" loop
specificMessage: Remove this call to "wait" or move it into a "while" loop.

ruleName: Restricted Identifiers should not be used as Identifiers
specificMessage: Rename this variable to not match a restricted identifier.

ruleName: Overrides should match their parent class methods in synchronization
specificMessage: Make this method "synchronized" to match the parent class implementation.

ruleName: Assignments should not be made from within sub-expressions
specificMessage: Extract the assignment out of this expression.

ruleName: XML signatures should be validated securely
specificMessage: Set the 'org.jcp.xml.dsig.secureValidation' property to "true" on the 'DOMValidateContext' object to validate this XML signature securely.

ruleName: "default" clauses should be last
specificMessage: Move this default to the end of the switch.

ruleName: Non-primitive fields should not be "volatile"
specificMessage: Use a thread-safe type; adding "volatile" is not enough to make this field thread-safe.

ruleName: Static fields should not be updated in constructors
specificMessage: Remove this assignment of "processors".

ruleName: Declarations should use Java collection interfaces such as "List" rather than specific implementation classes such as "LinkedList"
specificMessage: The type of "actual" should be an interface such as "SortedMap" rather than the implementation "TreeMap".

ruleName: "BigDecimal(double)" should not be used
specificMessage: Use "BigDecimal.valueOf" instead.

ruleName: Using hardcoded IP addresses is security-sensitive
specificMessage: Make sure using this hardcoded IP address is safe here.

ruleName: Return of boolean expressions should not be wrapped into an "if-then-else" statement
specificMessage: Replace this if-then-else statement by a single return statement.

ruleName: Unused labels should be removed
specificMessage: Remove this unused label.

ruleName: "equals(Object obj)" should test argument type
specificMessage: Add a type test to this method.

ruleName: Insecure temporary file creation methods should not be used
specificMessage: Use "Files.createTempDirectory" to create this directory instead.

ruleName: Blocks should be synchronized on "private final" fields
specificMessage: "graph" is a method parameter, and should not be used for synchronization.

ruleName: Conditionally executed code should be reachable
specificMessage: Change this condition so that it does not always evaluate to "true"

ruleName: Encryption algorithms should be used with secure mode and padding scheme
specificMessage: Use a secure padding scheme.

ruleName: Unused method parameters should be removed
specificMessage: Remove this unused method parameter "geomType".

ruleName: Silly math should not be performed
specificMessage: Remove this silly call to "Math.ceil"

ruleName: Empty arrays and collections should be returned instead of null
specificMessage: Return an empty collection instead of null.

ruleName: "entrySet()" should be iterated when both the key and value are needed
specificMessage: Iterate over the "entrySet" instead of the "keySet".

ruleName: Collapsible "if" statements should be merged
specificMessage: Merge this if statement with the enclosing one.

ruleName: Exception types should not be tested using "instanceof" in catch blocks
specificMessage: Replace the usage of the "instanceof" operator by a catch block.

ruleName: Case insensitive string comparisons should be made without intermediate upper or lower casing
specificMessage: Replace these toUpperCase()/toLowerCase() and equals() calls with a single equalsIgnoreCase() call.

ruleName: Vararg method arguments should not be confusing
specificMessage: Cast this argument to 'String' to pass a single element to the vararg method.

ruleName: Silly equality checks should not be made
specificMessage: Remove this call to "equals"; comparisons between unrelated types always return false.

ruleName: Constructors of an "abstract" class should not be declared "public"
specificMessage: Change the visibility of this constructor to "protected".

ruleName: Type parameters should not shadow other type parameters
specificMessage: Rename "T" which hides a type parameter from the outer scope.
